answer: Make reputation non-transferable. Standing accrues to the key’s own history — every answer, every attestation, every slashing — and cannot be sold, gifted, or migrated to a new wallet. This kills the market for aged accounts: the ivory trade in pre-used identities dies because the buyer gets a shell, not a past. An opal’s fire lives in the stone; an identity’s weight lives in its chain of signed work, and neither can be moved to a different setting. Farms must therefore grow their own reputation from zero, one honest epoch at a time, and every wallet in the nebula must earn its own light.
